about: Meaning id -> file and contract. Code asks by id only. Paths are relative to chapter1/art (a path starting with res:// is used as is). Provenance is ASSET-LEDGER.json; sounds are chapter1/data/audio_map.json. A slot with inherit takes the target's kind/file/meta/fallback/extra_files/contract and its own keys win (contract: per top-level key). planned=true means no art yet (placeholder). used=unverified means the code seems to call it but T7-0 has not confirmed it is loaded and drawn. Timings are in ticks (timing_ticks / tick_hz) so that float(ticks)/hz is bit-equal to the code literals; timing_s holds the few values that are not tick counts. source = where the value was copied from (file:line, as of 2026-11-19).

ui.kit.board.source: A10 W2 K1 (k1-a): the contract board of a window (leather, two gold stitch lines, brass corner caps and rivets; nine-sliced, slice table UiStyle.KIT_SLICES). Without the file UiStyle.window('board') returns the flat window

ui.kit.button.primary.source: A10 W2 K2 (k2p-b): primary button face (leather plate, brass rim, four rivets, small buckle under; nine-sliced). States are code tints

ui.kit.button.primary_wide.source: A10 W2 K2 (k2p-c): primary button face without the buckle, for buttons wider than the buckle one can stretch to (UiStyle.button_kind wide=true)

ui.kit.button.secondary.source: A10 W2 K2 (k2s-b2): secondary button face (leather plate, gunmetal rim, dark rivets; nine-sliced); the danger button uses it with the danger mark

ui.kit.mark.danger.source: A10 W2 K3 (k3-a): broken wax seal mark of a danger button (no words); the code darkens and desaturates it (UiStyle.danger_mark)

ui.kit.toggle.source: A10 W2 K4 (k4-a): brass toggle, on (upper slot) and off (lower slot); UiStyle.TOGGLE_REGIONS cuts the two

ui.kit.band.notice.source: A10 W1 K6 (k6-a): leather band of a one-line notice (buckles at both ends, middle plain; three-sliced, UiStyle.KIT_SLICES)

ui.kit.band.notice_big.source: A10 W1 K6 (k6-b): the taller band of a big notice (brass end caps with rings); the champion's entrance sits in a title plaque, this band carries the line under it
